sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Sixth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIX OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(SIXTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXIX OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance,
2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P.. Extraordinary, 22nd August, 2002]
No. LEGIS: 1 (18)/70-IX/6335
dated 22-8-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance called the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government Amendment) Ordinance 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
